welcome_message: 👋 Welcome to MediaDownloader! I can help you download videos and audio from YouTube, TikTok and other platforms.
help_message: 📋 Available commands: /yt [link] - Download YouTube video /tt [link] - Download TikTok video /music [link] - Download audio (MP3) /help - Help
yt_usage:
❌ Please provide a YouTube video link
Example: /yt https://youtube.com/watch?v=...
tt_usage:
❌ Please provide a TikTok video link
Example: /tt https://tiktok.com/@user/video/...
music_usage:
❌ Please provide a video link
Example: /music https://youtube.com/watch?v=...
author: Author
without_watermark: Video will be downloaded without watermark
playlist_not_supported: ❌ Playlists are not yet supported for this source
